description: This file defines the NewtonRaphson class used for solving equations using the Newton-Raphson method within statistical distribution calculations in PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: NewtonRaphson
classes.description: Implements the Newton-Raphson iterative method for finding roots of a function, used in statistical distribution calculations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NewtonRaphson instance with a callback function representing the function for which the root is sought.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the Newton-Raphson iteration to find the root of the function at a given probability, with a maximum number of iterations.
